Purpose: Identify the hazardous condition or source of harm described in the report.
Allowed_Values: Free text using standardized hazard names; use Unknown if not supported.
Labeling_Rule: Use the hazard explicitly described or clearly supported by the narrative. Do not infer a hazard without evidence.

Purpose: Identify the control/barrier intended to prevent the hazardous event.
Allowed_Values: Standardized barrier/control; use Unknown if not supported.
Labeling_Rule: Record the preventive or protective control relevant to the event.

Purpose: Describe how the barrier was missing, inadequate, bypassed, or failed.
Allowed_Values: Free text using concise standardized wording; use None Identified when appropriate.
Example: Isolation not performed or not verified
Labeling_Rule: Only label a failure when the source supports it. Do not invent a failed barrier.

Purpose: Describe the serious/fatal outcome that could reasonably have occurred.
Allowed_Values: Serious injury; Fatality; Fire/Explosion with injury potential; Toxic exposure; Dropped-object impact; Other supported consequence; Unknown.
Labeling_Rule: Focus on credible potential consequence, not only the actual outcome.

Purpose: Classify whether the report contains Serious Injury/Fatality potential.
Allowed_Values: SIF Potential; Non-SIF Potential; Needs Review
Labeling_Rule: Use SIF Potential when the report describes a credible exposure/event that could reasonably result in serious injury or fatality. A no-injury near miss can still be SIF Potential.

Purpose: Give a short evidence-based explanation for the SIF classification.
Example: Worker was exposed to uncontrolled energy during maintenance.
Labeling_Rule: Mention the key exposure/hazard + failed or absent barrier + credible severe consequence when supported.

Purpose: Map the report to the most relevant IOGP Life-Saving Rule.
Allowed_Values: Use the Life-Saving Rule named in the source where available; otherwise map only when clearly supported; else Unknown.
Labeling_Rule: Prefer the source's stated primary rule. Do not force a rule when evidence is insufficient.

Purpose: Capture a second relevant Life-Saving Rule when supported.
Allowed_Values: One additional IOGP Life-Saving Rule or blank.
Labeling_Rule: Use only when the report supports a meaningful secondary rule.

Purpose: Track whether the record is ready for model-training use.
Labeling_Rule: Use Needs Review when interpretation is uncertain; do not force a label.
High = directly supported; Medium = reasonable interpretation; Low = ambiguous.

Purpose: Document important ambiguity or evidence for later HSE review.
Example: Source describes exposure but does not explicitly state whether isolation was verified.
Labeling_Rule: Use for unresolved interpretation, source-quality issues, or reviewer comments.
